people.name: Josias
people.description: King of Judah who held the great Passover and died after the battle at Megiddo.

people.name: Solomon
people.description: King of Israel, son of David, builder of the temple; ancestor-figure of 'Solomon's servants'.

people.name: David
people.description: King of Israel; his ordinances for the Levites and singers are cited.

people.name: Moses
people.description: Lawgiver whose book and commandments are cited.

people.name: Aaron
people.description: First chief priest, ancestor of the priests and of Esdras.

people.name: Helkias
people.description: High priest under Josias, a ruler of the temple at the Passover; also an ancestor of Esdras.
people.identity_note: 1:8 parallels 2 Chr 35:8 (Hilkiah); 8:1 parallels Ezra 7:1 (Hilkiah). Both treated as the same high priest, as in the project.

people.name: Zacharias
people.description: A ruler of the temple who gave Passover offerings under Josias.

people.name: Esyelus
people.description: A ruler of the temple who gave Passover offerings under Josias.

people.name: Jeconias
people.description: Levite captain over thousands who gave Passover animals under Josias.
people.identity_note: Parallel 2 Chr 35:9 Conaniah. Not the king Jeconiah/Jehoiachin.

people.name: Samaias
people.description: Levite captain who gave Passover animals under Josias; brother of Nathanael.

people.name: Nathanael
people.description: Levite captain, brother of Samaias, at Josias' Passover.

people.name: Sabias
people.description: Levite captain at Josias' Passover.

people.name: Ochielus
people.description: Levite captain at Josias' Passover.

people.name: Joram
people.description: Levite captain at Josias' Passover.
people.identity_note: Doubtful: positional parallel is Jozabad (2 Chr 35:9); the name differs.

people.name: Asaph
people.description: David's chief musician; the temple singers are 'the sons of Asaph'.

people.name: Zacharias
people.description: Named with Asaph and Eddinus as the singers' ancestral leaders appointed by David.
people.identity_note: Doubtful: in the parallel 2 Chr 35:15 the trio is Asaph, Heman and Jeduthun; 1 Esdras has Zacharias in Heman's position.

people.name: Eddinus
people.description: Musician 'who represented the king', named with Asaph.

people.name: Samuel
people.description: Prophet; no such Passover had been kept since his time.

people.name: Pharaoh
people.description: King of Egypt who fought Josias at Megiddo, deposed Joachaz and installed Joakim.
people.identity_note: Unnamed beyond 'Pharaoh the king of Egypt'; parallel 2 Chr 35:20-36:4 names him Neco.

people.name: Jeremy
people.description: The prophet whose warnings went unheeded and who lamented Josias.

people.name: Joachaz
people.description: Son of Josias, king for three months before the king of Egypt deposed him.
people.identity_note: 'Zarakes' (1:38), the brother whom Joakim 'brought up out of Egypt', stands where 2 Chr 36:4 has Jehoahaz carried to Egypt; merged here by parallel position, but doubtful (Greek Zarakes may reflect a different name).

people.name: Joakim
people.description: Son of Josias made king by the king of Egypt; bound and taken to Babylon by Nabuchodonosor.
people.identity_note: Brother of Joachaz (1:37). Not the same as the Joakim of 1:43b (his son) or Joakim son of Zorobabel (5:5).

people.name: Joakim
people.description: Son of Joakim; reigned three months and ten days before being brought to Babylon.
people.identity_note: 1 Esdras calls Jehoiachin 'Joakim' like his father; parallel 2 Chr 36:9 (Jehoiachin, age 8; 2 Kgs 24:8 age 18).

people.name: Nabuchodonosor
people.description: King of Babylon who deported the kings of Judah, took the temple vessels, and destroyed Jerusalem.

people.name: Sedekias
people.description: Last king of Judea, made king by Nabuchodonosor; reigned eleven years and rebelled.

people.name: Cyrus
people.description: King of the Persians who decreed the return and the rebuilding of the temple.

people.name: Mithradates
people.description: Treasurer of Cyrus who handed over the temple vessels to Sanabassar.

people.name: Sanabassar
people.description: Governor of Judea who received the temple vessels from Cyrus and laid the temple's foundations.
people.identity_note: Greek form of Sheshbazzar (Ezra 1:8, 5:14-16). The project index has no separate Sheshbazzar: it lists 'Sheshbazzar' as an alias of zerubbabel-1ch3. 1 Esdras 6:18 names Zorobabel and Sanabassarus as two people, so a separate entry is proposed; reviewer should decide whether to merge.

people.name: Artaxerxes
people.description: King of the Persians who halted the rebuilding of Jerusalem and later commissioned Esdras.
people.identity_note: Ch. 2 parallels Ezra 4:7-23; ch. 8 parallels Ezra 7-8. The project has a single 'artaxerxes'.

people.name: Belemus
people.description: Official in Samaria who wrote against the Jews to Artaxerxes.

people.name: Mithradates
people.description: Official in Samaria who wrote against the Jews to Artaxerxes.

people.name: Tabellius
people.description: Official in Samaria who wrote against the Jews to Artaxerxes.

people.name: Rathumus
people.description: The 'recorder' who led the complaint to Artaxerxes and stopped the building.

people.name: Beeltethmus
people.description: Official named with Rathumus in the correspondence with Artaxerxes.
people.identity_note: Probably arose from the Aramaic title be'el te'em ('commander, chancellor') given to Rehum in Ezra 4:8-9, 17, but 1 Esdras treats it as a separate person. Kept separate; may not be a real individual.

people.name: Samellius
people.description: The scribe who joined Rathumus in writing against Jerusalem.

people.name: Darius
people.description: King of the Persians; held the feast and the bodyguards' contest and authorized the temple's completion.
people.identity_note: Darius I (cf. Ezra 4:24-6:15). Refs include 'the king' verses in ch. 3-4 that clearly mean him.

people.name: first bodyguard
people.description: Young man of Darius' bodyguard who argued that wine is strongest.

people.name: second bodyguard
people.description: Young man of Darius' bodyguard who argued that the king is strongest.

people.name: Apame
people.description: Concubine of King Darius, daughter of Barticus, whose power over the king Zorobabel cites.
people.identity_note: Described as 'the king's concubine'; listed under spouses for that reason.

people.name: Barticus
people.description: 'The illustrious' father of Apame, Darius' concubine.
people.identity_note: Spelled 'Barticus' in this WEB text (other English versions: Bartacus).

people.name: Zorobabel
people.description: Third bodyguard who won Darius' contest with 'truth is strongest', then led the return and rebuilt the temple as governor.
people.descent_note: Called 'son of Salathiel' (5:5, 5:48, 5:56, 6:2), 'of the house of David, of the lineage of Phares' (5:5). 1 Chr 3:19 makes Zerubbabel son of Pedaiah and grandson of Shealtiel, so Salathiel is not listed as parent.
people.identity_note: Identified as the third bodyguard in 4:13. Note the project lists Sheshbazzar as an alias of this id; 1 Esdras distinguishes Sanabassar (see that entry).

people.name: Salathiel
people.description: Ancestor (named as father) of Zorobabel.

people.name: Jesus
people.description: High priest, son of Josedek, who led the return with Zorobabel and rebuilt the altar and temple.
people.identity_note: Jeshua/Joshua the high priest. At 9:19 (parallel Ezra 10:18) the project codes the clan head as jeshua-1ch24 and his father as 'jozadak'; here treated as the same high priest.

people.name: Josedek
people.description: Father of Jesus the high priest; son of Saraias.

people.name: Saraias
people.description: Priest, father of Josedek and grandfather of Jesus the high priest.

people.name: Phinees
people.description: Grandson of Aaron; ancestor of the priestly families and of Esdras.

people.name: Phares
people.description: Son of Judah; Zorobabel's line is traced to him.

people.name: Joakim
people.description: Named in 5:5 as son of Zorobabel among those who went up.
people.identity_note: No parallel. Not found among Zerubbabel's sons in 1 Chr 3:19-20. Possibly a corruption of Joiakim son of Jeshua (Neh 12:10, id joiakim); kept separate.

people.name: Nehemias
people.description: One of the leaders who returned with Zorobabel; forbade the unregistered priests from the holy things.
people.identity_note: Parallel Ezra 2:2 / Neh 7:7 Nehemiah (not Nehemiah son of Hacaliah).

people.name: Zaraias
people.description: Leader who returned with Zorobabel.

people.name: Resaias
people.description: Leader who returned with Zorobabel.

people.name: Eneneus
people.description: Leader who returned with Zorobabel.

people.name: Mardocheus
people.description: Leader who returned with Zorobabel.
people.identity_note: Parallel Ezra 2:2 Mordecai; not Mordecai of Esther.

people.name: Beelsarus
people.description: Leader who returned with Zorobabel.

people.name: Aspharsus
people.description: Leader who returned with Zorobabel.

people.name: Reelias
people.description: Leader who returned with Zorobabel.
people.identity_note: Doubtful: positional parallel is Bigvai (Ezra 2:2); the name resembles Reelaiah, who already corresponds to Resaias.

people.name: Roimus
people.description: Leader who returned with Zorobabel.

people.name: Baana
people.description: Leader who returned with Zorobabel.

people.name: Phoros
people.description: Ancestor of a returning lay clan (2,172 in 5:9); some descendants had foreign wives.
people.identity_note: Parallel Ezra 2:3 and 10:25 Parosh. 8:30 is coded separately to parosh-ezr8, following the project's split.

people.name: Saphat
people.description: Ancestor of a returning clan.

people.name: Ares
people.description: Ancestor of a returning clan.

people.name: Phaath Moab
people.description: Ancestor of a large returning clan.

people.name: Jesus
people.description: Sub-clan ancestor within Phaath Moab.

people.name: Joab
people.description: Sub-clan ancestor within Phaath Moab.

people.name: Elam
people.description: Ancestor of a returning clan; some descendants had foreign wives.

people.name: Zathui
people.description: Ancestor of a returning clan.
people.identity_note: Zathoes (8:32) matches LXX Ezra 8:5 (MT lacks Zattu there); Zamoth (9:28) parallels Ezra 10:27 Zattu.

people.name: Chorbe
people.description: Ancestor of a returning clan.
people.identity_note: Doubtful: positional parallel Ezra 2:9 Zaccai; the name and number (705 vs 760) differ.

people.name: Bani
people.description: Ancestor of a returning clan; some descendants had foreign wives.
people.identity_note: Banias (8:36) parallels LXX Ezra 8:10; Mani (9:30) parallels Ezra 10:29 'sons of Bani'.

people.name: Bebai
people.description: Ancestor of a returning clan.
people.identity_note: 'Babi' (8:37) is the clan; the father 'Bebai' in the same verse is a separate entry (bebai-ezr8).

people.name: Astad
people.description: Ancestor of a returning clan.
people.identity_note: 8:38 gives both 'Azgad' and 'Astath', a doublet of the same name.

people.name: Adonikam
people.description: Ancestor of a returning clan.

people.name: Bagoi
people.description: Ancestor of a returning clan.

people.name: Adinu
people.description: Ancestor of a returning clan.

people.name: Ater
people.description: Ancestor of a returning clan (sons of Ater, of Ezekias).

people.name: Ezekias
people.description: Sub-clan ancestor within Ater.

people.name: Kilan
people.description: Ancestor of a returning clan (with Azetas, 67).

people.name: Azetas
people.description: Ancestor of a returning clan (with Kilan, 67).

people.name: Azaru
people.description: Ancestor of a returning clan (432).

people.name: Annis
people.description: Ancestor of a returning clan (101).

people.name: Arom
people.description: Ancestor of a returning clan; some descendants had foreign wives.
people.identity_note: Arom (5:16) is doubtful: it stands where Neh 7:22 has Hashum (just before Bezai). Asom (9:33) clearly parallels Ezra 10:33 Hashum.

people.name: Bassai
people.description: Ancestor of a returning clan (323).

people.name: Arsiphurith
people.description: Ancestor of a returning clan (112).
people.identity_note: Doubtful: parallel position and number (112) match Ezra 2:18 Jorah / Neh 7:24 Hariph; name differs.

people.name: Jeddu
people.description: Ancestor of a returning priestly house.
people.descent_note: 'Son of Jesus' (5:24) reflects Ezra 2:36 'of the house of Jeshua'; not a literal parent.

people.name: Jesus
people.description: Priestly house ancestor named with Jeddu.

people.name: Sanasib
people.description: Priestly ancestor among whose sons the house of Jeddu is counted.
people.identity_note: No parallel in Ezra 2:36 / Neh 7:39 (possibly related to Eliashib); kept separate.

people.name: Emmeruth
people.description: Ancestor of a returning priestly house; some descendants had foreign wives.

people.name: Phassurus
people.description: Ancestor of a returning priestly house; some descendants had foreign wives.

people.name: Charme
people.description: Ancestor of a returning priestly house (1,017).

people.name: Jesus
people.description: Levite leader with Kadmiel who oversaw the temple work and taught the law.
people.identity_note: Levite Jeshua (Ezra 2:40, 3:9; Neh 8:7). The 'sons of Jesus' in 5:58 are his.

people.name: Kadmiel
people.description: Levite leader, 'brother' of Jesus the Levite.

people.name: Bannas
people.description: Levite clan ancestor named with Jesus, Kadmiel and Sudias.
people.identity_note: No exact parallel in Ezra 2:40 (perhaps Bani/Binnui).

people.name: Sudias
people.description: Levite clan ancestor whose sons helped lead the temple work.
people.identity_note: Doubtful. Sudias (5:26) stands where Ezra 2:40 has Hodaviah; Joda (5:58, 'son of Iliadun') stands where Ezra 3:9 has 'the sons of Judah' (= Hodaviah; project id has alias Judah). Both merged into hodaviah-ezr2 by parallel position; the parent link to Iliadun is unique to 1 Esdras.

people.name: Salum
people.description: Ancestor of returning gatekeepers.

people.name: Atar
people.description: Ancestor of returning gatekeepers.

people.name: Tolman
people.description: Ancestor of returning gatekeepers.

people.name: Dacubi
people.description: Ancestor of returning gatekeepers.

people.name: Ateta
people.description: Ancestor of returning gatekeepers.

people.name: Sabi
people.description: Ancestor of returning gatekeepers.

people.name: Esau
people.description: Ancestor of a family of returning temple servants.
people.identity_note: Doubtful: positional parallel Ezra 2:43 Ziha. Not Esau son of Isaac.

people.name: Asipha
people.description: Ancestor of a family of returning temple servants.

people.name: Tabaoth
people.description: Ancestor of a family of returning temple servants.

people.name: Keras
people.description: Ancestor of a family of returning temple servants.

people.name: Sua
people.description: Ancestor of a family of returning temple servants.

people.name: Phaleas
people.description: Ancestor of a family of returning temple servants.

people.description: Ancestor of a family of returning temple servants.

people.description: Ancestor of a family of returning temple servants.

people.description: Ancestor of a family of returning temple servants.

people.name: Accaba
people.description: Ancestor of a family of returning temple servants.

people.name: Subai
people.description: Ancestor of a family of returning temple servants.

people.name: Anan
people.description: Ancestor of a family of returning temple servants.

people.name: Cathua
people.description: Ancestor of a family of returning temple servants.

people.name: Geddur
people.description: Ancestor of a family of returning temple servants.
people.identity_note: Parallel Ezra 2:47 Giddel (Gahar is missing in 1 Esdras).

people.name: Jairus
people.description: Ancestor of a family of returning temple servants.

people.name: Daisan
people.description: Ancestor of a family of returning temple servants.

people.name: Noeba
people.description: Ancestor of a family of returning temple servants.

people.name: Chaseba
people.description: Ancestor of a family of returning temple servants.

people.name: Gazera
people.description: Ancestor of a family of returning temple servants.

people.name: Ozias
people.description: Ancestor of a family of returning temple servants.

people.name: Phinoe
people.description: Ancestor of a family of returning temple servants.

people.name: Asara
people.description: Ancestor of a family of returning temple servants.

people.name: Basthai
people.description: Ancestor of a family of returning temple servants.

people.name: Asana
people.description: Ancestor of a family of returning temple servants.

people.name: Acub
people.description: Ancestor of a family of returning temple servants.

people.name: Achipha
people.description: Ancestor of a family of returning temple servants.

people.name: Asur
people.description: Ancestor of a family of returning temple servants.

people.name: Pharakim
people.description: Ancestor of a family of returning temple servants.

people.name: Basaloth
people.description: Ancestor of a family of returning temple servants.

people.name: Meedda
people.description: Ancestor of a family of returning temple servants.

people.name: Cutha
people.description: Ancestor of a family of returning temple servants.

people.name: Charea
people.description: Ancestor of a family of returning temple servants.

people.name: Barchus
people.description: Ancestor of a family of returning temple servants.

people.name: Serar
people.description: Ancestor of a family of returning temple servants.

people.name: Thomei
people.description: Ancestor of a family of returning temple servants.

people.name: Nasi
people.description: Ancestor of a family of returning temple servants.

people.name: Atipha
people.description: Ancestor of a family of returning temple servants.

people.name: Assaphioth
people.description: Ancestor of a family of 'the servants of Solomon' who returned.
people.identity_note: Doubtful: parallel Ezra 2:55 Hassophereth (Sotai, listed first in Ezra, has no counterpart).

people.name: Pharida
people.description: Ancestor of a family of 'the servants of Solomon' who returned.

people.name: Jeeli
people.description: Ancestor of a family of 'the servants of Solomon' who returned.

people.name: Lozon
people.description: Ancestor of a family of 'the servants of Solomon' who returned.

people.name: Isdael
people.description: Ancestor of a family of 'the servants of Solomon' who returned.

people.name: Saphuthi
people.description: Ancestor of a family of 'the servants of Solomon' who returned.

people.name: Agia
people.description: Ancestor of a family of 'the servants of Solomon' who returned.

people.name: Phacareth
people.description: Ancestor of a family of 'the servants of Solomon' who returned.
people.identity_note: Phacareth + Sabie together render Pochereth-hazzebaim (Ezra 2:57); the WEB punctuation splits them into two 'sons of'.

people.name: Sarothie
people.description: Ancestor of a family of 'the servants of Solomon' who returned.

people.name: Masias
people.description: Ancestor of a family of 'the servants of Solomon' who returned.

people.name: Gas
people.description: Ancestor of a family of 'the servants of Solomon' who returned.

people.name: Addus
people.description: Ancestor of a family of 'the servants of Solomon' who returned.

people.name: Subas
people.description: Ancestor of a family of 'the servants of Solomon' who returned.

people.name: Apherra
people.description: Ancestor of a family of 'the servants of Solomon' who returned.

people.name: Barodis
people.description: Ancestor of a family of 'the servants of Solomon' who returned.

people.name: Saphat
people.description: Ancestor of a family of 'the servants of Solomon' who returned.
people.identity_note: No parallel in Ezra 2 / Neh 7; distinct from the lay clan Saphat of 5:9.

people.name: Allon
people.description: Ancestor of a family of 'the servants of Solomon' who returned.
people.identity_note: Doubtful: positional parallel Ezra 2:57 Ami / Neh 7:59 Amon.

people.name: Charaathalan
people.description: Named as leading the returnees who could not prove their Israelite descent.
people.identity_note: Corresponds to the place names Cherub and Addan (Ezra 2:59); 1 Esdras presents it as a leader. Questionable as a real individual.

people.name: Dalan
people.description: Ancestor of returnees who could not show their lineage.
people.identity_note: Parallel Ezra 2:60 Delaiah. Ezra lists Delaiah, Tobiah and Nekoda as separate clans; 'son of Ban' is unique to 1 Esdras.

people.name: Ban
people.description: Named as father of Dalan.
people.identity_note: Stands where Ezra 2:60 has Tobiah; kept separate.

people.name: Nekodan
people.description: Ancestor of returnees who could not show their lineage.

people.name: Obdia
people.description: Ancestor of a priestly family excluded for lack of records.
people.identity_note: Doubtful: parallel Ezra 2:61 Habaiah / Neh 7:63 Hobaiah.

people.name: Akkos
people.description: Ancestor of a priestly family excluded for lack of records.

people.name: Jaddus
people.description: Priest who married Augia, daughter of Zorzelleus, and took his father-in-law's name.
people.identity_note: Parallel Ezra 2:61 / Neh 7:63, where this priest is called by the adopted name Barzillai; 1 Esdras gives his own name Jaddus.

people.name: Augia
people.description: Daughter of Zorzelleus, wife of the priest Jaddus.
people.identity_note: Named only in 1 Esdras; Ezra 2:61 says 'one of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite' (descent rather than literal daughter is likely).

people.name: Zorzelleus
people.description: Ancestor (Barzillai the Gileadite) after whom the priest Jaddus was named.
people.identity_note: Parallel Barzillai the Gileadite (Ezra 2:61). Augia is probably a descendant rather than a literal daughter of David's contemporary.

people.name: Attharias
people.description: Named with Nehemias as ruling that the unregistered priests must not eat the holy things.
people.identity_note: From the Persian title Tirshatha ('the governor', Ezra 2:63 / Neh 7:65). The governor there is unnamed (Zerubbabel or Sheshbazzar are usual guesses); 1 Esdras makes it a personal name. Kept separate.

people.name: Emadabun
people.description: Levite whose sons helped lead the temple work.
people.identity_note: Probably corresponds to Henadad (Ezra 3:9); not mapped because Iliadun also resembles Henadad.

people.name: Iliadun
people.description: Named as father of Joda, a Levite.

people.name: Asbasareth
people.description: King of the Assyrians who settled the adversaries in the land.

people.name: Aggaeus
people.description: Prophet who urged the rebuilding of the temple.

people.name: Zacharius
people.description: Prophet, 'son of Addo', who urged the rebuilding of the temple.
people.descent_note: 'Son of Addo' (6:1): Zech 1:1 makes Zechariah son of Berechiah and grandson of Iddo, so Addo is not listed as parent.

people.name: Addo
people.description: Ancestor of the prophet Zacharius.

people.name: Sisinnes
people.description: Governor of Syria and Phoenicia who questioned the rebuilding and reported to Darius.

people.name: Sathrabuzanes
people.description: Official with Sisinnes who questioned the rebuilding.

people.name: Esdras
people.description: Priest and scribe of the law who led a second return under Artaxerxes and enforced the dissolution of foreign marriages.
people.descent_note: Called 'son of Azaraias, son of Zechrias, son of Helkias ... son of Aaron' (8:1-2), a telescoped priestly genealogy (cf. Ezra 7:1-5, where Ezra is 'son of' Seraiah, killed in 586 BC). Azaraias not listed as literal parent.

people.name: Azaraias
people.description: Ancestor of Esdras, named as his father in 8:1.
people.identity_note: Doubtful. Ezra 7:1 reads 'Ezra son of Seraiah, son of Azariah, son of Hilkiah'; this WEB text has 'Azaraias, son of Zechrias, son of Helkias' (other Greek witnesses: Saraias, Ezerias, Helkias). Mapped by name to Azariah son of Hilkiah; the 'son of Zechrias' link conflicts with 1 Chr 6:13.

people.name: Zechrias
people.description: Named in Esdras' genealogy between Azaraias and Helkias.
people.identity_note: No counterpart in Ezra 7:1 or 1 Chr 6:13; probably a textual corruption. Kept separate.

people.name: Salem
people.description: High-priestly ancestor of Esdras.

people.name: Sadduk
people.description: High-priestly ancestor of Esdras.

people.name: Ahitob
people.description: High-priestly ancestor of Esdras.

people.name: Amarias
people.description: High-priestly ancestor of Esdras.

people.name: Ozias
people.description: High-priestly ancestor of Esdras.
people.descent_note: 'Son of Memeroth' (8:2) follows the telescoped Ezra 7:3; 1 Chr 6:7-10 places several generations between Meraioth and this Azariah.

people.name: Memeroth
people.description: Priestly ancestor of Esdras.

people.name: Zaraias
people.description: Priestly ancestor of Esdras.

people.name: Savias
people.description: Priestly ancestor of Esdras.

people.name: Boccas
people.description: Priestly ancestor of Esdras.

people.name: Abisne
people.description: Priestly ancestor of Esdras.

people.name: Eleazar
people.description: Son of Aaron, priestly ancestor of Esdras.

people.name: Gerson
people.description: Priestly head of the sons of Phinees who returned with Esdras.

people.name: Ithamar
people.description: Son of Aaron; ancestor of a priestly house.

people.name: Gamael
people.description: Priestly head of the sons of Ithamar who returned with Esdras.
people.identity_note: Doubtful name: parallel Ezra 8:2 has Daniel in the same position.

people.name: Attus
people.description: Davidic head who returned with Esdras.
people.identity_note: Parallel Ezra 8:2-3 Hattush. 1 Esdras reads 'Attus the son of Sechenias', attaching Ezra 8:3a's Shecaniah to him; 1 Chr 3:22 makes Hattush a son of Shemaiah son of Shecaniah.

people.name: Sechenias
people.description: Named as father of Attus.
people.identity_note: Doubtful: parallel Ezra 8:3 'of the sons of Shecaniah' (project id shecaniah-ezr8). Possibly the Davidic Shecaniah (shecaniah-1ch3).

people.name: Phoros
people.description: Clan ancestor of Zacharais, who returned with Esdras.
people.identity_note: Same clan as Phoros of 5:9, but the project codes Ezra 8:3 Parosh as a separate id (parosh-ezr8); followed here.

people.name: Zacharais

dated_events.event: Josias keeps the Passover in Jerusalem
Cyrus proclaims the return and the rebuilding of the temple

notes:
Method: every name was mapped by aligning 1 Esdras with its Hebrew parallels in the same WEB file (1:1-58 = 2 Chr 35:1-36:21; 2:1-15 = Ezra 1; 2:16-30 = Ezra 4:7-24; 3:1-5:6 unique; 5:7-73 = Ezra 2:1-4:5 / Neh 7:6-73; 6:1-7:15 = Ezra 5-6; 8:1-9:36 = Ezra 7-10; 9:37-55 = Neh 7:73-8:12). The project's verse-level claims (data/*/claims.yaml) were used to pick the exact existing id at each parallel verse. Where a list aligns one-to-one with Ezra/Nehemiah, corrupt Greek names were mapped by position and flagged 'Doubtful' in identity_note. Where the order breaks down (9:21 Harim, 9:34 Baani/Ezora), names were mapped only on name similarity, and unmatched names became new entries.
Project-structure issues for the reviewer: (1) the index has no separate Sheshbazzar (it is an alias of zerubbabel-1ch3), but 1 Esd 6:18 distinguishes Zorobabel and Sanabassarus, so new_id sheshbazzar-1es is proposed. (2) The project splits Parosh (parosh-ezr2 / parosh-ezr8), Joab (joab-ezr2 / joab-ezr8), Bebai, Kelaiah/Kelita and Shabbethai (ezr10 / neh8). These splits are followed, so some same-name 1 Esdras entries map to different ids. (3) Jesus son of Josedek at 9:19 is mapped to joshua-ezr2/jehozadak, although the project codes Ezra 10:18 as jeshua-1ch24/jozadak. (4) Sudias (5:26) and Joda (5:58) are merged into hodaviah-ezr2.
Text oddities: 1:43 calls Jehoiachin 'Joakim' like his father; 1:38 'Zarakes' is merged with Joachaz (doubtful); 4:29 spells Barticus; 5:5 makes Joakim a son of Zorobabel (no parallel); 5:24 Jeddu 'son of Jesus' reflects 'house of Jeshua'; the 8:1 genealogy in this text reads Azaraias son of Zechrias (Ezra 7:1: Seraiah son of Azariah); 8:35 has a stray 'Jezelus'; 8:38 'Astath' and 'Akatan' are doublets of Azgad and Hakkatan; 5:34 'Phacareth, Sabie' = Pochereth-hazzebaim. Beeltethmus (2:16), Levis (9:14), Attharias (5:40), Attharates (9:49) and Charaathalan (5:36) come from titles, a class word or place names that 1 Esdras reads as personal names; they are kept (Attharates mapped to Nehemiah), but each is flagged.
Scope: clan eponyms in 5:9-35, 8:29-40 and 9:19-35 are treated as persons because the project indexes the Ezra 2/8/10 eponyms as persons. Town names in 5:17-23 and Meunim/Nephisim are excluded, consistent with the project. Unnamed individuals included: the first and second bodyguards of Darius (the third is Zorobabel, 4:13). 'Pharaoh' (Neco) is included by title.
Reign lengths stated: Joachaz 3 months (1:35), Jehoiachin 3 months 10 days (1:44), Sedekias 11 years (1:46); ages at accession are in explicit_ages.
dated_events: month numbers use the 1st month = Nisan reckoning; regnal_year is null where the text gives only month/day.
